trigger.purpose: add terminal message hygiene for dangerous actionable fragments embedded in record text fields

rationale: Add a narrow terminal message-safety check for information/reporting answers that quote record text fields. The terminal preserves the already-selected outcome, but must not reproduce credential-harvesting URLs, shell/tool commands, or process-override text from a data field when a redaction or description preserves the requested business facts.

dependencies.why: Live answer-format contract: the yes/no <YES>/<NO> token and response-shaping rules the terminal preflight reads from the live /AGENTS.MD rather than hardcoding.
Defines submit_and_exit as the terminal helper that writes the answer via ws.answer and exits the snippet.

rollback.strategy: Retire this version to fall back to v0008 if the message-safety check over-redacts legitimate answer payloads.
